description: Read the live Heat: heat holds tokens screened by TIA and ranked by Heat score; new holds just-spotted tokens not yet screened (higher risk). Each token is an opaque id with rank, Heat score, price, liquidity, volume, price changes and entry time; pass id to trnch_buy or trnch_sell. Returns nextSince: pass it back as since to get only new entries, and dedupe by id. Poll at most every few seconds. Requires the API key from trnch_register, sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

since.description: nextSince from the previous call (ms timestamp or ISO date). Omit on the first call.

name: trnch_heat
title: Read the Heat feed
